name: OpenTelemetry explicit-target producer
authority_scope: An explicitly targeted telemetry signal corroborates that the instrumented producer emitted the represented span or log observation.
limitations: Span or log names are never used to infer AuditSpec boundaries.
Telemetry is attributed by default and does not prove business intent or authorization semantics.
A single signal is point evidence and does not imply exhaustive runtime coverage.
